The Android twin of every iOS symbol, its status and the migration score are in the [Android API map](Android-API-Map.md) (generated by `scripts/android-api-map.py`). |

| `tabpages` | 纯 Kotlin：页面注册表与配置规则（`TabPageRegistry`、`TabConfiguration`、`TabConfigurationFormats`），`cyltabbar` 依赖它 | Pure Kotlin: the page registry and the configuration rules (`TabPageRegistry`, `TabConfiguration`, `TabConfigurationFormats`); `cyltabbar` depends on it |
| `app` | 演示：用 iOS 库自带的配置文件创建 `CYLTabBarController`，PlusButton、角标、点击动画、双击，以及两个 TabBar 共用页面 ID 的场景；四个 Tab 是从 iOS Example 移植的演示列表（见 [Android 演示迁移](Android-Demo-Migration.md)） | The demo: a `CYLTabBarController` from the iOS library's own configuration file, a plus button, badges, the tap animation, the double tap, and two tab bars sharing page IDs; the four tabs are the demo lists ported from the iOS Example (see [Android demo migration](Android-Demo-Migration.md)) |

## [CN]用法
## [EN]Usage

```kotlin
// [EN] Pages registered by page ID (the same IDs as the iOS demo). [CN] 按页面 ID 注册页面（与 iOS 演示相同的 ID）。
CYLTabBarPageRegistry.sharedRegistry.registerPageProvider({ id, attributes -> HomeFragment() }, "home")
CYLPlusButton.registerPlusButton(MyPlusButton.Provider)          // optional 可选

// [EN] From the iOS library's configuration file (an asset or a path), or from code. [CN] 由 iOS 库的配置文件（asset 或路径）或代码创建。
val controller = CYLTabBarController.tabBarControllerWithConfigurationFile(activity, "cyl_tabbar_configuration.json")
// val controller = CYLTabBarController(activity, listOf(HomeFragment(), MeFragment()), listOf(
//     mapOf(CYLConstants.CYLTabBarItemTitle to "Home", CYLConstants.CYLTabBarItemImage to "home_icon"),
//     mapOf(CYLConstants.CYLTabBarItemTitle to "Me", CYLConstants.CYLTabBarItemImage to "me_icon")))
activity.setContentView(controller.view)

controller.delegate = object : CYLTabBarControllerDelegate {
    override fun tabBarController_didSelectViewController(tabBarController: CYLTabBarController, viewController: Fragment) {}
}
controller.tabBar.tabBarButtonArray[1].cyl_showBadgeValue("12")   // badges 角标
controller.cyl_loginRequiredTabBarItemIdentifiers = listOf("me")  // login (#19) 登录拦截
controller.cyl_tabButtonTapAnimationType = CYLEnums.CYLTabButtonTapAnimationType.Bounce
controller.cyl_defaultTabButtonAnimation = CYLTabButtonBlockAnimation().apply { selectAnimation = { _, icon, _ -> icon.rotation = 0f } }
// [EN] Animated icons: any tab with CYLTabBarAnimationFilePath plays with lottie-android / libpag / rive-android when the app has it.
// [CN] 动画图标：App 引入 lottie-android / libpag / rive-android 时，带 CYLTabBarAnimationFilePath 的 Tab 会播放动画。
CYLBadgeAppearance.globalAppearance.backgroundColor = Color.MAGENTA   // app-wide badges (#425) 全局角标外观
controller.cyl_themeManager.currentThemeIdentifier = "dark"       // themes (#216) 换肤
```

```java
// [EN] The same API from Java. [CN] Java 中同样的 API。
CYLTabBarController controller = new CYLTabBarController(activity, configuration);
CYLBadgeKt.cyl_showBadgeValue(controller.getTabBar().getTabBarButtonArray().get(0), "3");
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 图片：配置中的 `"system:house"` 或图片名称通过 `CYLTabBarConfiguration.imageResolver` 解析为 drawable（默认按名称查找 drawable 资源，或文件路径）；演示把 SF Symbol 名称映射到 Android 图标。 | Images: `"system:house"` or an image name in a configuration goes through `CYLTabBarConfiguration.imageResolver` (by default a drawable resource of that name, or a file path); the demo maps the SF Symbol names to Android icons. |
| 页面为 Fragment，由控制器的 `FragmentManager` 以 show / hide 管理，因此切换 Tab 保留页面状态；`selectedIndex`、`viewControllers`、`reloadTabBarItemsWithAttributes`、`replaceViewControllerAtIndex` 与 iOS 相同。 | Pages are Fragments managed by the controller's `FragmentManager` with show / hide, so switching tabs keeps their state; `selectedIndex`, `viewControllers`, `reloadTabBarItemsWithAttributes` and `replaceViewControllerAtIndex` work as on iOS. |
| PlusButton：子类化 `CYLPlusButton`（图片 + 可选标题，`cyl_plusButtonWithImage(...)`），用一个 `CYLPlusButtonSubclassing` 对象提供 iOS 的类方法（`plusButton`、`indexOfPlusButtonInTabBar`、`multiplierOfTabBarHeight` / `constantOfPlusButtonCenterYOffset…`（未实现时按 iOS 预设：居中，或更高的按钮底边对齐 TabBar 底边）、`plusChildViewController`、`shouldSelectPlusChildViewController`、`tabBarContext`、`alignsTitleWithTabBarItemTitles`（标题与 Tab 标题同一中心线、相同字体与颜色）、`tabBarItemIdentifier`、`contentImage` / `selectedContentImage` / `selectedContentView`），`CYLPlusButton.registerPlusButton(provider)` 注册。按钮凸出 TabBar 的部分按 `touchableRect`（`touchableAreaScale`、`touchableAreaOutsets`，#91）响应点击，`showsTouchableArea` 可绘制该区域；角标与任何视图一样。 | The plus button: subclass `CYLPlusButton` (an image + an optional title, `cyl_plusButtonWithImage(...)`) and provide the iOS class methods through a `CYLPlusButtonSubclassing` object (`plusButton`, `indexOfPlusButtonInTabBar`, `multiplierOfTabBarHeight` / `constantOfPlusButtonCenterYOffset…` (not implemented: the iOS preset, centered, or a taller button's bottom on the bar's bottom), `plusChildViewController`, `shouldSelectPlusChildViewController`, `tabBarContext`, `alignsTitleWithTabBarItemTitles` (the title on the tab titles' line, with their font and colors), `tabBarItemIdentifier`, `contentImage` / `selectedContentImage` / `selectedContentView`), registered with `CYLPlusButton.registerPlusButton(provider)`. The part of the button above the bar takes touches by `touchableRect` (`touchableAreaScale`, `touchableAreaOutsets`, #91), `showsTouchableArea` draws that area; badges work like on any view. |
| 页面辅助（`UIViewController+CYLTabBarControllerExtention`，Fragment 扩展）：`cyl_tabIndex`、`cyl_tabBarItemIdentifier`、`cyl_tabButton`、页面所在 Tab 的角标（`cyl_showBadgeValue` 等）、`cyl_popSelectTabBarChildViewControllerAtIndex / ForClassType / ForTabBarItemIdentifier`、`cyl_pushViewController`（子 Fragment 加入返回栈，代替导航控制器）、`cyl_handleNavigationBackAction`。 | Page helpers (`UIViewController+CYLTabBarControllerExtention`, Fragment extensions): `cyl_tabIndex`, `cyl_tabBarItemIdentifier`, `cyl_tabButton`, the badge of the page's tab (`cyl_showBadgeValue`...), `cyl_popSelectTabBarChildViewControllerAtIndex / ForClassType / ForTabBarItemIdentifier`, `cyl_pushViewController` (a child Fragment on the back stack stands in for the navigation controller), `cyl_handleNavigationBackAction`. |
| 配置：`CYLTabBarConfigurationParser` 读取 iOS 的全部格式（JSON / JSON5 / JSONC、plist（XML、二进制、OpenStep）、strings、YAML、TOML、INI / properties / dotenv、XML、Protobuf 文本与二进制），检测顺序、错误码与边界（5 MB、64 层、XXE 关闭）与 iOS 相同；`CYLTabBarConfiguration` 按 iOS 规则规范化（平台 / 最低版本排除、重复标识重命名、查找顺序、自动注册开关），并转换 `"{t, l, b, r}"` 边距、`"#RRGGBB"` 颜色、`"bold:15"` 字体与动画键。`CYLURLRequest` 给出超时、请求头、方法与缓存。 | Configurations: `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser` reads every iOS format (JSON / JSON5 / JSONC, plists (XML, binary, OpenStep), strings, YAML, TOML, INI / properties / dotenv, XML, Protobuf text and binary) with the iOS detection order, error codes and limits (5 MB, 64 levels, XXE off); `CYLTabBarConfiguration` normalizes them with the iOS rules (platform / minimum version exclusion, duplicate identifiers renamed, the lookup order, the automatic flag) and converts `"{t, l, b, r}"` insets, `"#RRGGBB"` colors, `"bold:15"` fonts and the animation keys. `CYLURLRequest` gives the timeout, headers, method and cache. |
| 点击动画：`CYLTabButtonAnimation`（Java 接口，每个方法可选，`cyl_respondsToSelector` 判断是否实现）与 `CYLTabButtonScale / ZoomIn / Bounce / Rotation / Fume / Press / Block / Flip / FrameAnimation`，时长与关键帧同 iOS；控制器像 iOS 一样播放选中、取消选中、重选、按下 / 抬起与角标变化动画（页面的 `cyl_tabButtonAnimation` → `cyl_defaultTabButtonAnimation` → `cyl_tabButtonTapAnimationType`）。转场：代理返回 `CYLTabBarSlideTransitionAnimator`，`CYLTabBarInteractiveTransition` 由 `CYLPanGestureRecognizer` 驱动（不足 40% 取消）。 | Tap animations: `CYLTabButtonAnimation` (a Java interface, every method optional, `cyl_respondsToSelector` tells which are implemented) and `CYLTabButtonScale / ZoomIn / Bounce / Rotation / Fume / Press / Block / Flip / FrameAnimation`, with the iOS timings and keyframes; the controller plays select, deselect, reselect, press / release and badge-changed steps as iOS does (the page's `cyl_tabButtonAnimation`, then `cyl_defaultTabButtonAnimation`, then `cyl_tabButtonTapAnimationType`). Transitions: the delegate returns a `CYLTabBarSlideTransitionAnimator`; `CYLTabBarInteractiveTransition` follows a `CYLPanGestureRecognizer` (cancelled under 40 %). |
| 动画图标：`CYLTabBarItemAnimatorRegistry`、`CYLTabBarItemAnimationFactory`、`CYLTabBarItemAnimationPlayer`、`CYLTabBarItemViewAnimator`（简便路径）与 Lottie / PAG / Rive / GIF 的 animator：App 中有 lottie-android、libpag 或 rive-android 时通过反射自动注册（如同 iOS 只在链接动画库时编译 animator），没有时忽略其键并显示图片；GIF（#605，`CYLTabBarGIF…`）由系统解码，总会注册，选中时播放一次并停在最后一帧。选中的 Tab 播放，启动时选中的 Tab 显示最后一帧（#389），深色版本与颜色（#442、#216）随深色模式切换，`tabBarItemAnimationSpeed`（#428）。 | Animated icons: `CYLTabBarItemAnimatorRegistry`, `CYLTabBarItemAnimationFactory`, `CYLTabBarItemAnimationPlayer`, `CYLTabBarItemViewAnimator` (the short path) and the Lottie / PAG / Rive / GIF animators, registered by reflection when the app has lottie-android, libpag or rive-android (as iOS compiles an animator only with its library); without one, its keys are ignored and the image shows. GIF (#605, `CYLTabBarGIF…`) is decoded by the platform, so it is always registered: it plays once when the tab is selected and stays on its last frame. The selected tab plays, the tab selected at launch shows its last frame (#389), dark versions and colors (#442, #216) follow Dark Mode, `tabBarItemAnimationSpeed` (#428). |
| 主题：`CYLThemeManagerCenter`（按名称的管理器）、`CYLThemeColor` / `CYLThemeImage`（随主题切换的 Drawable）/ `CYLThemeEffect`（Android 12+ 的 `RenderEffect`），`View.cyl_setThemeColor`（代替 CALayer）、`cyl_registerThemeColorProperties`、`cyl_themeDidChangeBlock`；实现 `CYLThemeChangeObserving` 的视图与页面收到 `cyl_themeDidChangeByManager`。 | Themes: `CYLThemeManagerCenter` (managers by name), `CYLThemeColor` / `CYLThemeImage` (a Drawable that switches with the theme) / `CYLThemeEffect` (a `RenderEffect` on Android 12+), `View.cyl_setThemeColor` (instead of CALayer), `cyl_registerThemeColorProperties`, `cyl_themeDidChangeBlock`; views and pages that implement `CYLThemeChangeObserving` get `cyl_themeDidChangeByManager`. |
| 角标：`CYLBadgeAppearance.globalAppearance`（#425，视图上的值优先）、`CYLBadgeTextDisplaying`、`CYLTabBarBadgeView`，工具栏菜单项（`MenuItem.cyl_showBadgeValue`）、`CYLTabBarItem.badgeValue` 与角标扩展、iOS 的全部动画类型（含 …Once），示例行（`ImageView.cyl_showBadgeForRow`）、`CYLBadgeHelperTableViewController`、`Fragment.cyl_showNavigationBadgeValue`。 | Badges: `CYLBadgeAppearance.globalAppearance` (#425, a value on the view wins), `CYLBadgeTextDisplaying`, `CYLTabBarBadgeView`, toolbar menu items (`MenuItem.cyl_showBadgeValue`), `CYLTabBarItem.badgeValue` and its badge extensions, every iOS animation type (the …Once ones too), the sample rows (`ImageView.cyl_showBadgeForRow`), `CYLBadgeHelperTableViewController`, `Fragment.cyl_showNavigationBadgeValue`. |
| 内存警告（#426）：`unloadsUnselectedViewsOnMemoryWarning` 时，`onTrimMemory` / `onLowMemory` 分离未选中的 Tab（销毁视图、保留页面），选中时重新创建视图；`cyl_simulateMemoryWarning…`、`Fragment.cyl_simulateMemoryWarningAndShowResult`。导航：`CYLBaseNavigationController`（在根页面之上 push 时隐藏 TabBar）、`cyl_pushOrPopToViewController(…, callback)`。 | Memory warnings (#426): with `unloadsUnselectedViewsOnMemoryWarning`, `onTrimMemory` / `onLowMemory` detach the unselected tabs (views destroyed, pages kept), which create their views again when selected; `cyl_simulateMemoryWarning…`, `Fragment.cyl_simulateMemoryWarningAndShowResult`. Navigation: `CYLBaseNavigationController` (the tab bar hides above the root page), `cyl_pushOrPopToViewController(…, callback)`. |

## [CN]测试
## [EN]Tests

```sh
cd Example-Android
gradle :cyltabbar:testDebugUnitTest   # Robolectric + JUnit: the controller, animations, transitions, themes, badges, memory warnings, every configuration format
gradle :tabpages:test                 # 11 JVM tests of the registry and the configuration rules
gradle :app:assembleDebug             # the demo app (needs the Android SDK)
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| Robolectric 在 JVM 上运行控制器的测试（点击动画对象、转场、动画文件层（测试 animator 与真实的 lottie-android）、主题颜色 / 图片 / 视图、角标外观与示例、内存警告、登录拦截、角标、PlusButton 与子页面、PlusButton 标题对齐与 TabBar 上方的点击、页面辅助方法、重新加载、主题、共用配置文件与页面注册表、异步页面、TabBar 隐藏与滚动隐藏）。演示 App 只做了编译，**未在设备或模拟器上运行**，因此没有截图。 | Robolectric runs the controller's tests on the JVM (tap animation objects, transitions, the animation file layer (a test animator and the real lottie-android), theme colors / images / views, badge appearance and samples, memory warnings, login interception, badges, the plus button and its child, the plus title alignment and touches above the bar, the page helpers, reload, themes, the shared configuration file and the page registry, asynchronous pages, hiding the tab bar and scroll hiding). The demo app was only compiled, **not run on a device or an emulator**, so there are no screenshots. |

## [CN]限制
## [EN]Limits

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 迁移完成率 100 / 100（`docs/Android-API-Map.md`）：所有不是仅 iOS 的公开符号都已移植。PAG 与 Rive 通过反射调用 libpag / rive-android，只用 Robolectric 测试了注册与回退（这两个库带原生代码，无法在 JVM 上加载）；Lottie 用真实的 lottie-android 测试。 | Migration score 100 / 100 (`docs/Android-API-Map.md`): every public symbol that is not iOS-only is ported. PAG and Rive call libpag / rive-android by reflection and only their registration and fallback were tested with Robolectric (both libraries load native code, which the JVM cannot); Lottie was tested with the real lottie-android. |
| 仅 iOS（对照表中为 n/a，不计入完成率）：UIKit 类别、FlatDesign 的 KVC TabBar、液态玻璃（含 platter 镜片视图）、Core Animation、iPhone Duo 的竖向 TabBar（`allowsVerticalBar`）、不透明 TabBar 安全区的 UIKit bug 修复、iOS 演示的设置列表与本地化 bundle。 | iOS only (n/a in the map, left out of the score): the UIKit categories, FlatDesign's KVC tab bar, Liquid Glass (the platter lens view too), Core Animation, the iPhone Duo vertical bar (`allowsVerticalBar`), the UIKit bug fix for the safe area of opaque tab bars, the iOS demo's settings list and the localization bundle. |
| 滚动隐藏（#13）：与 iOS 一样，滚动隐藏的 TabBar 在切换 Tab、push / pop、弹窗或其他窗口获得焦点、Activity 暂停、键盘弹出、内存警告、关闭滚动隐藏之后恢复；App 自己用 `setTabBarHidden` 隐藏的 TabBar 保持隐藏，键盘弹出时滚动不隐藏。`ListView` 滚动不改变 `scrollY`，需要把滚动距离交给 `cyl_scrollDidChange`（演示列表即如此）。 | Scroll hiding (#13): as on iOS, a bar hidden by scrolling comes back after a tab switch, a push / pop, a dialog or another window taking the focus, the activity pausing, the keyboard, a memory warning, or scroll hiding turned off; a bar the app hid with `setTabBarHidden` stays hidden, and scrolling with the keyboard up does not hide it. A `ListView` scrolls without changing `scrollY`: pass the distance to `cyl_scrollDidChange` (the demo list does). |
| 差异：翻转动画的卷曲（direction 5、6）以图标上 / 下边为轴折叠（Android 没有翻页卷曲）；按压回弹用 Overshoot 插值代替弹簧；角标示例标题只有英文。 | Differences: the curl of the flip animation (direction 5, 6) folds the icon around its top / bottom edge (Android has no page curl); the press spring-back uses an overshoot interpolator instead of a spring; the badge sample titles are English only. |
